agreed_overrides.seniority_level: Junior (0 relevant / 6.4 total yrs — confirmed by user)
agreed_overrides.positioning_strategy: Frame as an early-career lab candidate with relevant degree training and high coachability rather than trying to imply prior clinical experience.
agreed_overrides.bullet_style: Use past-tense action verbs (e.g., Assisted, Managed, Supported) instead of gerunds or fragments.
agreed_overrides.register_control: Replace casual phrasing with professional, role-appropriate wording throughout CV sections.
agreed_overrides.content_completeness: Ensure each bullet contains a concrete responsibility or outcome, not a standalone noun phrase.
agreed_overrides.claim_quality: Remove cliché soft-skill labels unless supported by context, scope, or result.
agreed_overrides.transferable_framing: Translate retail experience into lab-relevant behaviours (accuracy, compliance, consistency, teamwork under workload).
agreed_overrides.professional_identity: Use competency-led statements rather than personality labels in Skills and Summary.
agreed_overrides.evidence_density: Add at least one concrete factual anchor to most bullets (scope, frequency, volume, or duration).
agreed_overrides.achievement_signal: Surface practical proof of reliability and accuracy using tenure and operational context when hard metrics are unavailable.
agreed_overrides.ats_alignment: Embed job-relevant technical terms only where truthful and context-backed by education or training exposure.
agreed_overrides.cover_letter_tone: Use confident, professional language that presents readiness rather than lack.
agreed_overrides.opening_strategy: Open with qualification relevance and laboratory training foundation, not comparative inexperience.
agreed_overrides.risk_language_filter: Remove self-deprecating, overly casual, or personally defensive statements from all paragraphs.
agreed_overrides.profile_voice: first person — the summary speaks as the candidate (implied first person, no name and no third-person pronouns)
